name: TensoRF Vector-Matrix Decomposition
definition: A factorization technique for the 4D feature volume in TensoRF, factorizing it as the sum of three outer products between a matrix and a vector, leveraging vector-matrix decomposition.
summary: TensoRF Vector-Matrix Decomposition reduces memory overhead by factorizing 4D neural feature volumes into structured low-rank vectors and matrices, unlike implicit coordinate-based decoding.
